name: Bamboo sticky rice
summary: Sticky rice roasted on the coals in a fresh tube of young lồ ô bamboo, then split open. It comes out soft and chewy, and smells more of rice and fresh bamboo than sticky rice from a steamer.
origin: Bao Dak Lak names cơm lam among the foods that start in Buon Ma Thuot, with grilled chicken and jar wine.
howToEat: Dip it in sesame salt, or eat it with grilled pork or grilled chicken. At Ko Tam it comes with the yard chicken and the jar wine.
where: Ko Tam community tourism area in Buon Ma Thuot, and Buon Tri A in Buon Don beside the Serepok.
seoTitle: Com lam in Buon Ma Thuot — sticky rice from the tube
seoDescription: Sticky rice roasted in a young bamboo tube, soft and chewy, eaten with sesame salt or grilled chicken at Ko Tam and Buon Tri A.
